sample_unit: patient messages with responses rated by PCPs

links.outcome: Linguistic complexity/readability of GenAI drafts versus HCP responses
links.effect: GenAI responses were more linguistically complex than HCP responses (mean [SD] score, 125.2 [47.8] vs 95.4 [58.8]; P = .002; difference, 31.2%), making them less readable.
links.quote: However, GenAI drafts were less readable than HCPs', a significant concern for patients with low health or English literacy.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of EHR-integrated LLM drafts for in-basket messages in a clinical pilot at 3 internal medicine practices, assessing usability, communication style, empathy, and linguistic complexity.
